description_excerpt: Job Description This position will be contracted through Bosch’s external vendor under a one-year agreement. About the Role We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Agile Scrum Master to join our Audio team, which develops core audio components for state-of-the-art Automotive Infotainment systems. In this role, you will act as a servant leader, coach, and mentor, helping the team build a great product that is highly valued by our customers.
